errors.message: custom measuring runs per frame on the host. Use Row, Column or Box with weight and align, FlowRow, or an app component.
raw pointer handlers run per event on the host. Use Modifier.clickable; draggable and anchoredDraggable come in MS4-47.
Scaffold's content takes the PaddingValues the host measures (a slot with a parameter: Gate B, part b). Use a Column with the TopAppBar and Modifier.weight(1f) on the content.

stubMessages.message: custom measuring runs per frame on the host. Use Row, Column or Box with weight and align, FlowRow, or an app component.
Modifier.layout, layoutId and onPlaced belong to custom layouts, which measure per frame on the host. Use Modifier.padding, size or offset, Row/Column/Box with weight and align, or an app component.
raw pointer handlers run per event on the host. Use Modifier.clickable; draggable and anchoredDraggable come in MS4-47.
gesture detectors read raw pointer events on the host. Use Modifier.clickable; draggable and anchoredDraggable come in MS4-47.
not yet: FlexBox and Grid are Compose 1.12's experimental API. Keliver generates them in a 0.5.x once Compose stabilises them. For now use Row, Column, Box or FlowRow.
not yet: Style is Compose 1.12's experimental API. Keliver generates it in a 0.5.x once Compose stabilises it. For now use modifiers and the theme.
text selection is not available in the guest: selection state is the host's. Leave it out.
a custom Indication runs per frame on the host. Leave it out: the theme's ripple applies.
custom layouts measure and place per frame on the host and can never run in the guest. Use Row, Column or Box with weight and align, FlowRow, or an app component.
raw pointer input runs per event on the host and can never run in the guest. Use Modifier.clickable; draggable and anchoredDraggable come in MS4-47.
a Modifier.Node runs inside the host's layout and draw passes and can never run in the guest. Compose the generated modifiers, or write the modifier in an app component.

this reads host measurements synchronously, which a guest cannot do. Size and position callbacks (onSizeChanged, onGloballyPositioned) come in MS4-46 as events with host values. Until then use an app component.

typeMessages.androidx.compose.ui.text.TextLayoutResul: a text layout result is measured on the host and cannot reach the guest. Use maxLines and overflow.
typeMessages.androidx.compose.foundation.text.TextAut: auto-sized text is not in the generated API yet (Gate B, part b). Use fontSize with maxLines and overflow.
typeMessages.androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush: brushes are Gate B. Use a solid Color.
typeMessages.androidx.compose.foundation.gestures.Fli: custom fling behaviour runs per frame on the host.
typeMessages.androidx.compose.foundation.OverscrollEf: custom overscroll runs per frame on the host.
interaction sources are host state (Gate B). Leave it out: the host makes its own, with the same press and ripple.
typeMessages.androidx.compose.foundation.Indication: custom indications run per frame on the host. Leave it out: the theme's ripple applies.
typeMessages.androidx.compose.material3.TopAppBarScro: scroll behaviours connect the bar to the host's nested scrolling (Gate B, part b).
typeMessages.androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Windo: window insets are the host's (Gate B, part b); the default applies.
typeMessages.androidx.compose.ui.unit.IntSize: sizes are measured on the host, and the end of the host's animation is not reported to the guest yet (Gate B-e). Leave it out.
